items.title: Bat Perched on an Open Book
items.alt: A friendly bat peeks over a large open red book with its wings spread behind the blank pages.
items.description: A friendly bat peeks over a large open red book with its wings spread behind the blank pages. Useful for reading reward cards.

items.title: Bat Above a Blank Pencil Label
items.alt: A smiling bat spreads two wings above a wide blank pencil-shaped label, two hind feet gripping the label's top edge.
items.description: A smiling bat spreads two wings above a wide blank pencil-shaped label, two hind feet gripping the label's top edge. Useful for classroom name labels.

items.title: Bat Perched on a Small Pumpkin
items.alt: A friendly bat rests on the stem of one squat pumpkin, wings partly raised for balance and both hind feet gripping the stem.
items.description: A friendly bat rests on the stem of one squat pumpkin, wings partly raised for balance and both hind feet gripping the stem. Useful for personal Halloween crafts.
